components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. When present it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the owner's
            'salutation' on the response.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Flat form, kept for backward
            compatibility; prefer the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form
            (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'). On the response
            this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present, falling back to the flat value.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (typically street number and name). Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            exactly 4 digits and valid for the owner's city, whose region fixes
            the allowed range (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. Once set it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the registrationDate. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint, supplied on create, declaring that this owner
            deliberately lives in the same household as an existing owner (same
            last name and postcode). A second owner in an existing household is
            otherwise rejected as a household duplicate (409); setting this flag
            bypasses that duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not
            stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the
                last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the unformatted
                E.164 value.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The unified stable owner identity assigned when the owner is
                created, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' (no separators)
                where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or
                'UNKNOWN' when no region can be derived), FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single
                Luhn check digit over the digits of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'
                prefix. It carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household,
                i.e. with the same last name (compared case-insensitively with
                collapsed whitespace) and postcode. Formatted 'HH-<HEX12>' where
                HEX12 is the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                the normalized last name, a '|' separator and the postcode. It is
                deterministic, so owners with the same last name and postcode share
                it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3A7F1C9B2E4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal-year number. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is named for the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate of 2026-08-01 yields 'FY27' and 2026-03-01
                yields 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                A derived points score, assigned on create: starting at 0, add 2
                when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for
                a household of 3 or more members, and add 3 when the owner's tenure
                (elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate to today) is more than
                one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                A derived numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and
                4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION segment
                of the customerCode (the text before its first '-'), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                A derived marketing segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known
                region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when more than 80 owners have already been
                created on this owner's registration day. Assigned on create and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when the owner's city (compared
                case-insensitively) already holds between 40 and 49 owners when
                this owner is created, signalling the city is approaching its
                capacity limit of 50. Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false

Let me verify the full implementation is coherent by confirming the memberId structure from the actual run: `NSW2716E6609E1` = `NSW` (region) + `27` (FY) + `16E6609E` (HASH8) + `1` (Luhn CHK over the digits of `NSW2716E6609E`). This matches the spec format `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`.

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` field formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit` field.

**`model/Owner.java`**
- Replaced the `customerCode` field (and its getter/setter) with `memberId` (column `member_id`).
- Replaced `customerCode(...)` with `memberId(postcode, telephone, lastName, registrationDate)`, which builds `REGION` (from postcode, default `UNKNOWN`) + two-digit `FY` (fiscal year of registration date) + `HASH8` (first 8 upper-hex of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone+lastName — the same hash the identity uses) + `CHK` (one Luhn digit over the digits of the `REGION+FY+HASH8` prefix).
- Removed the public `membershipNumber(...)` and `checkDigit(...)` methods; the Luhn logic is now a private `luhn(String)` helper used for `CHK`.
- Added `regionOf(String)` (region = leading letters) and a `fiscalYear(String memberId)` overload that reads the `FY` segment back out of the memberId.
- `primaryIdentifier()`, `locality(...)`, `timezone(...)`, and `ownerSegment()` now all derive from `memberId`.

**`service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`**
- `generateMemberId(...)` applies collision handling to the `memberId` (appending `-<n>`), replacing the old customer-code logic.
- The audit line and `OwnerCreatedEvent` now carry `memberId`.

**`service/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`** — record field/JSON property renamed to `memberId`.

**`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — dropped `membershipNumber`/`checkDigit` mappings and helpers; `fiscalYear`, `locality`, `timezone` now reference `memberId`; the ignore-on-create mapping updated to `memberId`.

**`resources/openapi.yml`** — replaced the `customerCode`/`membershipNumber`/`checkDigit` schema properties with `memberId`; updated the `locality` description.

**`resources/db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — `customer_code` column replaced with `member_id` (widened to 32 chars).

The acceptance test (asserting a `memberId` starting with `NSW`, containing the computed HASH8, with `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` absent) passes, and the full suite is green.
